BOOM DRINKWARE / SILICONE & PLASTIC PROCESSING

Material, tooling and finished-part requirements. One project brief.

BOOM Drinkware focuses on silicone and plastic processing for custom drinkware, coasters and barware components, connecting material selection, tooling, moulding, decoration and packing.

  • Silicone projects: define hardness, moulded details, trimming, colour and intended handling.
  • Plastic projects: review the selected resin, moulded appearance, cup rim, wall thickness and component fit.
  • Project handover: identify drawing revisions, approved samples, colours and packing requirements in the order.
Discuss your manufacturing project ↗

WHAT WE WORK ON

One project. Clear responsibilities.

Silicone processing

Silicone processing with hydraulic presses and rubber-refining equipment shown on our Alibaba company profile.

Plastic processing

Injection moulding supported by the mould-installation, injection-machine and production-floor photographs on our Alibaba company profile.

Additional barware supply

Stainless shakers and openers are sourced to the arrangement confirmed per model — quoted separately, with the source stated.

HOW IT WORKS

BEFORE PRODUCTION

Put measurable acceptance requirements into the order.

01

Material & revision

Identify the compound or resin, colour, drawing and sample revision.

02

Critical dimensions

Define the dimensions, tolerances and measurement conditions.

03

Visual acceptance

Use approved samples or images to define acceptable variation and defects.

04

Inspection scope

Agree sampling, functional and packing checks, plus specific documentation.

MATERIAL & PROCESS QUALITY CONTROL

Silicone: moulding and recovery.
Plastic: rim finish and component fit.

Start with the material and geometry. Turn appearance, dimensions, feel and intended handling into defined inspection points. Methods, tolerances, sampling and acceptance criteria are agreed for the order.

01

Silicone moulding & structure

For silicone cups, collapsible cups, coasters and flexible components.

  • Review the compound, colour and agreed hardness; define the measurement method and range for the project.
  • Check parting-line flash, short fills, bubbles, inclusions and demoulding tears against the agreed visual standard.
  • Review critical dimensions and contact edges. For flexible or collapsible designs, agree the folding, opening and recovery checks.
02

Plastic injection & appearance

For the selected PP, AS, ABS, Tritan or other specified resin and model.

  • Confirm resin and colour; review clear parts for dark specks, haze, flow marks and scratches.
  • Assess gate remnants, weld lines, sink marks and warpage in relation to the tool; focus on rim burrs and base stability.
  • Compare rim, wall and interface dimensions with the drawing or approved sample. Capacity, lid and straw fit are model-specific.
03

Decoration follows the substrate

Review artwork revision, position, registration and coverage. Flexible silicone and rigid plastics need material-specific adhesion criteria. Agree rub, adhesion and flex-check methods and conditions during sampling.

04

Assembly & packing follow the configuration

Review lid, seal, thread or snap-fit engagement and gaps. Specify leak, opening or functional checks only where relevant to the model, then confirm accessories, set contents, carton count and transit protection.

Define the inspection basis first: model and material, drawing revision, approved sample, critical dimensions, defect criteria and sampling plan. Food-contact, temperature and cleaning requirements need market- and model-specific documentation or testing arrangements.

PRICE / PAYMENT / SHIPPING

What the price covers, and how it ships.

Payment

  • T/T is standard for bulk. 30% deposit with the order, 70% against the B/L copy before the documents are released.
  • Bank charges run about USD 15–35 per transfer and sit with the buyer.
  • PayPal is accepted for samples and small trial orders. Not recommended for bulk — the fee is high on both sides.

Price basis and shipping

  • FOB Shenzhen. We quote the goods only; freight is not in the price.
  • You have a forwarder: we deliver to their warehouse and they take it from there.
  • You do not have one: we introduce a forwarder we work with regularly. Price and contract stay between you and them.

BOOM Drinkware / 硅胶与塑胶加工

把材料、模具和成品要求，放在同一个项目里。

BOOM Drinkware 主营硅胶与塑胶加工，面向杯具、杯垫及酒具配件的定制需求，连接选材、模具、成型、装饰和包装。

  • 硅胶项目：从软硬度、成型细节与产品结构出发，确定修边、配色和使用动作的检查重点。
  • 塑胶项目：结合所选树脂与杯型，核对注塑外观、杯口、壁厚及部件装配要求。
  • 定制交接：把图纸版本、确认样、颜色及包装要求写入订单，减少沟通中的歧义。
沟通你的加工项目 ↗

业务范围

一个项目，明确分工。

硅胶加工

硅胶加工，阿里国际站公司资料展示了液压机、炼胶机及相关生产设备。

塑胶加工

塑胶注塑加工，阿里国际站公司资料展示了安装模具、注塑成型及注塑机照片。

配套酒具供货

不锈钢调酒器与开瓶器按型号明确供货方式，单独报价并注明来源。

合作步骤

以样品为基础，确认生产需求。

01

明确需求

提供用途、数量、图稿与目的地。

02

确认方案

核对型号、配置、费用及周期。

03

批准样品

确认批准的图稿与样品版本。

04

生产与交付

确认检验、包装与交付要求。

生产前确认

把可核对的验收要求写进订单。

01

材料与版本

确认胶料或树脂、颜色、图纸与样品版本。

02

关键尺寸

在图纸上标出需检尺寸、公差及测量条件。

03

外观判定

用确认样或照片界定可接受边界与缺陷。

04

检查范围

约定抽样、功能与包装检查及专项资料要求。

材料与工艺质量控制

硅胶看成型与回弹，塑胶看杯口与装配。

检验从材料和结构出发。把客户关心的外观、尺寸、手感与使用动作，转化为可核对的检查项；具体方法、公差、抽样方案和验收条件随订单确认。

01

硅胶成型与结构

适用：硅胶杯、折叠杯、杯垫及软质配件。

  • 核对胶料、颜色与约定软硬度；硬度测量方法及范围按项目确认。
  • 查看分型线飞边、缺料、气泡、杂质及脱模撕裂，区分外观缺陷与正常结构线。
  • 复核关键尺寸和接触边缘；折叠或柔性结构按约定动作检查折叠、展开及回弹。
02

塑胶注塑与透明外观

适用：所选 PP、AS、ABS、Tritan 等树脂对应的型号。

  • 按订单核对树脂及颜色；透明件重点查看黑点、雾感、流痕和划伤。
  • 结合模具位置查看浇口残留、熔接线、缩水和变形，重点关注杯口毛刺与底部平稳性。
  • 对照图纸或确认样核对杯口、壁厚和接口；容量、杯盖及吸管适配按具体型号确认。
03

装饰质量，跟着基材走

核对图案版本、位置、套色与遮盖。硅胶的柔性表面与硬质塑胶不能套用同一附着要求；摩擦、附着及弯折检查的方法与条件在打样时确认。

04

装配与包装，按最终配置核对

核对杯盖、密封件、螺纹或卡扣的配合与间隙。仅对具有相应结构的型号约定密封、启闭或功能检查，并复核配件、单套内容、装箱数量与运输防护。

先把检验依据说清楚：所选型号与材料、图纸版本、确认样、关键尺寸、缺陷判定和抽样方案。食品接触、耐温及清洁适用性等专项要求，按目标市场与型号另行确认资料或检测安排。

价格 / 付款 / 运输

价格里含什么，货怎么出。

付款

  • T/T 电汇是大货的标准做法。下单付 30% 定金，见提单副本付余下 70%，款到放单。
  • 银行手续费约 15–35 USD 一笔，由买方承担。
  • PayPal 可以收，但只用于样品单和小试单。大货不建议——两边费率都太高。

价格与运输

  • FOB 深圳。我们只报货价，运费不在报价里。
  • 客户有货代：我们把货送到货代仓库，后续运输由货代负责。
  • 客户没有货代：我们推荐长期合作的货代直接对接，价格与合同在客户和货代之间。
